column3: Exercise
What is it? Trying to stop me?
I have no such intention, but is now the time to be quarreling!?
You have to give it straight to that girl. you know?
That - is - why I'm asking you to cool down your head!
That - is - why I'm telling you not to butt in this conversation!
Well, hold on. Listen...
It's fine, so stay quiet and watch.
Anyway, you're quite peculiar as well.
Me?!
Do you even know the meaning of teamwork?
Don't take me for a fool! I know that much!
Is that the attitude of someone who understands teamwork? You're just disrupting it.
I don't want to hear that from you!
I'm personally teaching you what teamwork is, so I'd like some gratitude.
Y-You...
What? Don't stay silent, say something.
I can't say anything due to sheer disbelief.
Right now, no one else but you is disrupting our teamwork.
...I have no idea what you're talking about.
I'll explain it so that even YOU can understand...
The kanji "person" is written in such a way, where one person supports the other.
That's straight from some drama!
Don't interrupt people.
Augh!
This is the reason why our teamwork is being disrupted.
Why can't you just understand that?
Hey, isn't that straight from a drama...?
Hehe, you didn't know.
She looks so proud, but this is such a cliché line.
Your moves in "Siscaly" are so poor that you instantly die!
There's no link between those two things!
Well, if you were to watch me play about a million times, perhaps you would become a slightly better human being.
Are you a Thief of Time?!
Huh? What was that?
You're taking precious time from my preparations for exams! Can you get to the point?
What were we talking about anyway?
Ah! T-That's right! Her! That black one!
A-A million times...
Ah, that's right. Also, upload my gameplay videos to Nico Douga.
Eh? What did you just say?
Recording, editing and commenting - I'll leave them up to you.
I'm taking the examinations afterwards...
Are you going to do it? Or not?
Don't give me that murderous look! I'll do it!
By the way, if the number of views doesn't increase... You know what'll happen...
...I will do my best.
Anyway, if you don't know what teamwork is, then there is no use helping one another.
Hey! Are you listening!
I'm listening! I am!
Anyway, lower your fist!
Really, I'm tired of having such a stupid elder brother...
Seriously... I'm the one who is tired of having such a horrible little sister...
